description.narrative: At CBD COP 15 in December 2022, the Conference of the Parties called on the Global Environment Facility (GEF) to establish a fund to support the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF). This so-called Global Biodiversity Framework Fund (GBFF) was then ratified at the seventh GEF Assembly in Vancouver in August 2023. With the payment of 40 million euros announced by Federal Environment Minister Steffi Lemke in September 2023, Germany, together with Canada and the United Kingdom, provided the necessary boost to make the GBFF operational. Thereby Germany supports the conservation, restoration and sustainable use of biodiversity as envisaged in the GBF, such as the protection of at least 30 percent of the world's land, waters and seas, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories as well as halting and reversing the loss of biodiversity.
